title: Two-Way Frequency Table
description: A 2×2 contingency table of counts with row and column totals and a grand total. Serves Problem-Solving and Data Analysis (probability-conditional): conditional probability, relative frequency, and association questions. Only the four inner cells are authored — totals are derived.

cells.description: cells[r][c] = count in row r, column c. At least one cell must be positive (renderer validates).

cornerLabel.description: Label for the top-left corner cell describing the row variable; null leaves it blank.

showTotals.description: Append the Total row and Total column. Set false when the question asks students to compute them.

notes: Renderer guarantees: row totals, column totals, and grand total are COMPUTED from cells — they are never parameters, so totals can never contradict inner cells; totals row/column are bolded with a double rule; an all-zero table is rejected at parse time.
